title: Cass Review meta-appraisal: commitment manifest
description: Hash-chained, append-only commitment manifest for Eden Openly's structured meta-appraisal of the Cass Review (2024) and its commissioned systematic reviews. Each entry records the SHA-256 of a record that is fixed before the outcome it constrains exists (for example, a randomised draw), together with the SHA-256 of the manifest before that entry. Each manifest state is timestamped with OpenTimestamps, which anchors it in the Bitcoin blockchain. The committed records themselves are published later; a commitment is not a publication. To verify entry n, take the first n lines of manifest.jsonl and check manifest-NNNNNN.ots against them.
